case_name: Vivek Kumar @ Sanju And Anjali @ Afsana vs The State, Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi And Tahir ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Vivek @ Sanju and Anjali @ Afsana (husband and wife)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State, Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi And Tahir (father of petitioner No. 2)

facts_of_case: Petitioners Vivek Kumar @ Sanju and Anjali @ Afsana sought quashing of FIR No. 160/2006 alleging kidnapping of petitioner No. 2. Petitioner No. 2 was a Muslim who converted to Hinduism and married petitioner No. 1 without her father's consent.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the person alleging kidnapping to prove that the minor was taken away without the consent of the lawful guardian.
legal_principles.held: A bare perusal of Section 361 IPC would show that in order to constitute kidnapping, it was necessary to prove that the minor was taken away without the consent of the lawful guardian.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not send a minor to Nari Niketan without considering the circumstances and ensuring her safety.
legal_principles.held: The request by the counsel for the complainant to send the petitioner No. 2 to Nari Niketan was declined by the Court.
use_in: cases involving minors and allegations of abuse

outcome.final_order: FIR quashed, no useful purpose served if FIR remains on record.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for quashing FIR
advising on marriage and conversion rights
